background.name: Deep blue
background.job: Sky, ocean and the space around the diorama. All water is a lighter tint of this same blue.

water.name: Water tint (of deep blue)
water.job: Rain, rivers, reservoirs, flood water. Same hue as the background, lifted, never a new colour.

subject.name: Storm gray
subject.job: Land, terrain, clouds, roads, buildings: the main subject.

accent.name: Amber
accent.job: Warnings only: stressed levees, slide-prone slopes, the broken route, outages.

highlight.name: Recovery green
highlight.job: Recovering hills early on; recharge basins and refilled groundwater in the ending.

secondary.name: Warm grey
secondary.job: Stat labels, asides, 'illustrative scenario' tags, legend text.

panelFill.name: Charcoal
panelFill.job: Every caption, stats and legend panel (with an 18 px background blur).

panelEdge.name: Warm grey edge
panelEdge.job: 1.5 px panel outline and map-label halos.
